ic_split: walk-forward 60% train / 20% validation / 20% test split by chronological tape time with a 25-event embargo gap
independence_assumption: calendar trading sessions (days) are statistically independent; multiple symbols within the same day are clustered and not pooled

adverse_selection_96_to_99_pct.single_session_claim: 96–99% of filled passive orders are run over by price shortly after fill
adverse_selection_96_to_99_pct.verdict: Does not hold as a 96-99% bound. Overstated lower bound. Adverse selection is consistently present and statistically overwhelming (15/15 sessions t_nw < -64), but the fraction dips to 87.8% and never exceeds 97.4%.

fill_model_calibration_slope_1_03_to_1_0.cross_day_actual: AAPL range: 0.941–1.492 (mean 1.122); QQQ range: 0.669–1.133 (mean 0.949); pooled range: 0.669–1.492 (mean 1.035)
fill_model_calibration_slope_1_03_to_1_0.verdict: Does not hold. The 1.03-1.09 range was an artifact of 12/30/2019. Cross-day dispersion is wider (std 0.160), with QQQ under-predicting on low-fill days and AAPL over-predicting on volatile days.

ic_step_0_14_to_0_46.single_session_claim: Rank IC rises with forecast horizon: ≈0.14 (h=1) → ≈0.23 (h=25) on AAPL and ≈0.16 → ≈0.46 on QQQ
ic_step_0_14_to_0_46.cross_day_actual: AAPL mean IC: 0.1530 (h=1) -> 0.2541 (h=10) -> 0.2399 (h=25); QQQ mean IC: 0.1833 (h=1) -> 0.3902 (h=25). Full cross-day range across all sessions: 0.1125 to 0.4749.
ic_step_0_14_to_0_46.verdict: Partially holds. The sign is strictly positive on 15/15 sessions (100% consistency). However, AAPL plateaus between h=10 and h=25 rather than monotonically rising, and QQQ range is 0.1461 to 0.4749.

drift_unit: ITCH fixed-point price ticks ($0.0001, where 100 ticks = $0.01 standard cent)
